modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Murphy (knee) is probable for Friday's game against Minnesota.
injury.detail: Murphy is expected to keep his absence with a knee injury to a one-game minimum. Herbert Jones is likely to revert back to the bench Friday.

injury.shortComment: Johnson is questionable to suit up for Friday's game against Washington.
injury.detail: Johnson hasn't played since spraining his left ankle during Saturday's 121-99 loss to the Pelicans, and he's now questionable to suit up for Friday's matchup versus the Wizards. The Hawks have won two straight in his absence, so there's at least some good news for Atlanta. If Johnson is forced to miss a third consecutive contest, the 2026 All-Star forward's next opportunity to play will come against the Nets at home on Saturday.

injury.shortComment: Shannon (hip) is questionable for Friday's game against New Orleans.
injury.detail: Shannon is in danger of missing a third straight game while tending to a bruised left hip. He'll presumably need to prove his health during shootaround and warmups to gain clearance to play Friday night.

injury.shortComment: Davis is questionable for Friday's game against the Hawks due to a right ankle sprain, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Davis picked up the ankle injury during Wednesday's matchup against Atlanta but managed to stay in the game and finish with 26 points in 30 minutes. The Wizards will likely monitor him closely in shootaround and pregame warmups to determine if he suits up Friday evening.

injury.shortComment: Christie (hip) is probable for Friday's game against the Jazz.
injury.detail: The swingman is primed to end a one-game absence Friday due to a hip injury. Christie had been starting at shooting guard for the Mavericks before getting hurt, but it remains to be seen if 2024 No. 1 overall pick Zaccharie Risacher has played well enough to keep his hold on a starting job.

injury.shortComment: Proctor (ankle) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the 76ers.
injury.detail: Proctor sprained his left ankle in the fourth quarter of Wednesday's 124-116 loss to the Thunder and did not return. The 22-year-old is one of several Cavaliers currently dealing with an injury, as Jaylon Tyson (ankle), Peyton Watson (hamstring) and Jarrett Allen (knee) are all banged up. Proctor's next chance to play comes Saturday against the Knicks on the second leg of Cleveland's back-to-back set.

injury.shortComment: Pritchard (eye) is questionable for Friday against Charlotte, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.
injury.detail: Pritchard is day-to-day after leaving Wednesday's win over the Bucks early. Meanwhile, Jayson Tatum (rest) has been cleared to return. Guys like Baylor Scheierman and Mike Conley could see more run if Pritchard is unable to give it a go.

injury.shortComment: Watson (hamstring) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.
injury.detail: Watson has missed his team's last two matchups due to a hamstring issue, and he's in danger of missing a third Friday. More information on his availability should come to light as tipoff nears.

injury.shortComment: Mamukelashvili (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Portland.
injury.detail: Mamukelashvili is under the weather and could miss his first game of the season Friday. If the big man is unable to suit up, Jarred Vanderbilt and Jake LaRavia would be candidates to see increased minutes.

injury.shortComment: Schroder (thigh) is questionable for Friday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: The veteran floor general is at risk of missing his first game of the year Friday. Working back from a preseason calf strain, Coby White could be thrust into a larger role at point guard if Schroder is unable to play.

injury.shortComment: Barnes (groin) is questionable to play Friday's game against the Bucks.
injury.detail: Barnes played 32 minutes during Wednesday's 128-109 loss to the Nuggets, but he's been deemed questionable to suit up Friday due to left adductor/groin soreness. If he's unable to play against Milwaukee, Allen Graves, Jamison Battle and Collin Murray-Boyles are candidates to see increased minutes.

injury.shortComment: Allen (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against Philadelphia.
injury.detail: Allen picked up a right knee injury during Wednesday's clash against the Thunder and failed to return. He'll presumably be monitored closely leading up to tipoff to determine if he can take the court Friday night.

injury.shortComment: Diabate (quadriceps) is questionable for Friday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: Diabate is in danger of sitting out Friday for the first time this season. Ryan Kalkbrenner would likely be called upon to make a spot start at center for the Hornets if Diabate is sidelined, with Royce O'Neale likely mixing in as a small-ball center in this case.

injury.shortComment: Bona (back) is doubtful to play in Friday's game against the Cavaliers, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Bona is dealing with a cervical spine sprain after exiting Wednesday's 112-106 win over Detroit with what was initially called a head injury. Dean Wade and Jabari Walker would stand to benefit if Bona can't play in Cleveland.
